points.quote: IF IT IS NOT CLEARLY INDICATED BY TEACHING STAFF AND/OR DEPARTMENT GUIDELINES – NO GENAI IS PERMITTED.
points.anchor: 5.2 Acceptable use of GenAI in assessments
points.gist: Unless teaching staff or department guidelines clearly indicate otherwise, no GenAI is permitted in assessments.

points.quote: Using GenAI in an assignment beyond what is permitted is a breach of academic integrity (including plagiarism).
points.anchor: 5.1 Is it a breach of academic integrity (including plagiarism) to submit assignments that have been wholly or partly created by GenAI?
points.gist: Using GenAI in an assignment beyond what is permitted is a breach of academic integrity, including plagiarism.

points.quote: No GenAI output (including paraphrased) in final submission.
points.anchor: 5.2 Acceptable use of GenAI in assessments
points.gist: In the research-and-structuring category, no GenAI output, including paraphrased, may appear in the final submission.

points.quote: GenAI can be used as an editing tool to improve the clarity or quality of assessment. It may not be used to create new content.
points.anchor: 5.2 Acceptable use of GenAI in assessments
points.gist: In the editing category GenAI may improve clarity or quality but may not create new content.

points.quote: GenAI may be used throughout the assessment process, including the inclusion of GenAI output within the assessment.
points.anchor: 5.2 Acceptable use of GenAI in assessments
points.gist: In the full-assistance category GenAI may be used throughout, including GenAI output in the submission.

points.quote: A full list of prompts and GenAI outputs should also be included as an appendix.
points.anchor: 5.2 Acceptable use of GenAI in assessments
points.gist: Under full GenAI assistance, a full list of prompts and outputs should be included as an appendix.

points.quote: Students using software with GenAI components should ensure that these are deactivated. If this is not possible, such software should not be used.
points.anchor: 5.2 Acceptable use of GenAI in assessments
points.gist: Where no GenAI is permitted, students should deactivate GenAI components in their software, or not use that software.

points.quote: The student declaration of use will be attached to every assignment submission sheet.
points.gist: A student declaration of use will be attached to every assignment submission sheet.

points.quote: Turnitin also provides teaching staff with a second score outlining possible GenAI use (students will not have access to this). This Turnitin GenAI score is not definitive proof of GenAI use.
points.gist: Turnitin gives staff, not students, a GenAI score, which is not definitive proof of GenAI use.

points.quote: GenAI tools will not be used by staff to grade or provide feedback on students’ assessed work.
points.gist: Staff will not use GenAI tools to grade or give feedback on students' assessed work.

points.quote: Never put your personal data or anyone else’s into a GenAI tool.
points.anchor: 4.2 What tools are available to use at MU?
points.gist: Never enter your own or anyone else's personal data into a GenAI tool.

points.quote: Microsoft’s Copilot is accessible to all MU students, and we currently have a data agreement in place with Microsoft, which means that our use of Copilot is GDPR-compliant.
points.anchor: 4.2 What tools are available to use at MU?
points.gist: Copilot is available to all MU students under a data agreement with Microsoft, making its use GDPR-compliant.

points.quote: Recording and transcribing of lectures, tutorials and meetings, etc., without prior consent.
points.anchor: 2. Limitations, Disadvantages, and Inappropriate Use of GenAI
points.gist: Listed as inappropriate use: recording and transcribing lectures, tutorials and meetings without prior consent.

points.quote: All use of GenAI should be acknowledged in academic work, including citations and referencing where appropriate and according to departmental handbooks.
points.gist: All GenAI use should be acknowledged in academic work, with citations and referencing following departmental handbooks.

points.quote: Data Centres, on which GenAI tools rely, consumed 21% of all electricity in Ireland in 2023 (CSO, 2024).
points.anchor: 3.1 What should I consider before using GenAI?
points.gist: Data centres consumed 21% of all electricity in Ireland in 2023.
